findings.claim: The workflow's frozen installs will fail because package.json changes scripts/devDependencies without any corresponding pnpm-lock.yaml update in the diff.
findings.evidence: The package.json hunk adds many new dependencies and scripts, including @cucumber/cucumber, eslint, semver, tsx, yaml, etc., while .github/workflows/publish.yml runs `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` in all jobs; the packet contains no pnpm-lock.yaml diff.
findings.suggested_fix: Regenerate and commit pnpm-lock.yaml with pnpm 10.33.0 after the package.json changes, or remove the package.json dependency changes.
